Package net.maswag.falcaun.verification

Class NumericSULVerifier

java.lang.Object
net.maswag.falcaun.verification.NumericSULVerifier
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class NumericSULVerifier extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Verifies a Numeric System Under Learning (NumericSUL) against specified properties using various equivalence oracles and model checking techniques.

This class provides a framework for verifying the behavior of a numeric system under learning by comparing it against a set of Signal Temporal Logic (STL) properties. It uses learning algorithms, equivalence oracles, and model checkers to identify any discrepancies between the expected and actual behaviors.

Author:
Masaki Waga <masakiwaga@gmail.com>

    • getEqEvaluationCount

      public int getEqEvaluationCount()
      Returns the number of the evaluations of input words by the equivalence oracles.

      This is not necessarily the number of the SUL executions by the equivalence oracles. For example, the corner-case equivalence oracle counts every evaluated word, including the ones answered by a cache, while the robustness-based equivalence oracles count only the actual executions.

      Returns:
      the number of the evaluations of input words by the equivalence oracles
